Hi Riya,

I am applying for the UI/UX Designer role at Schbang, as I admire how your team balances high-end visual aesthetics with functional product requirements.

In my current role at Ascent Business Solutions, I built reusable design systems that significantly reduced turnaround time for corporate communications. Previously, at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and translated findings directly into improved user flows and interface designs.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates my end-to-end process from initial research to a refined verification experience: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

I am currently based in Nagpur and am fully prepared to relocate to Mumbai for this position. Would you be open to a brief 15-minute call to discuss how my background in both visual design and technical systems can support your current projects?

Ananya

Hi Chris,

I saw your opening for a Junior Graphic Designer focused on packaging and listing images, and my background in print production and template design at Ascent Business Solutions makes this a great fit.

At Ascent, I produced over 100 digital and print creatives while building reusable design systems and templates that cut turnaround time for corporate communications. I also managed print-ready file requirements like bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.

My commercial visual identity work at AT Creation demonstrates my ability to handle precise layouts and brand assets, which you can see in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Could we take a brief look at one of my layout case studies together this week?

Ananya
